thread:
sam: Heads-up — new user on Windows + WSL quickstart hit two different failures: TLS handshake error in WSL curl, then a 403 when they retried from Node in WSL.
liz: Can you paste exact error strings? Quickest way to triage.
sam: Curl: 'SSL: certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate'. Node SDK threw 'UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE' until they set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0, then the SDK call returned 403.
ankit: Sounds like corporate TLS interception or missing CA bundles in WSL. But the 403 after disabling TLS verification suggests a downstream auth/policy issue too.
ben: Do we have the trace id?
support-bot: (automated) Logs fetched for trace_id=tr_ABCD9876 -> response: 403, code=POLICY_RESTRICTED, billing_required=false
liz: billing_required=false + POLICY_RESTRICTED is odd. Those flags shouldn't contradict.
maya: I just tried to repro: created a workspace via SSO invite, created an API key, first call was 403 until I completed the Billing wizard in Console. I didn't get redirected to billing automatically after SSO invite.
sam: The user says they never saw any billing prompt. They used SSO invite. They checked Console -> Billing and it said "Active" though.
ankit: Two separate failures here: (1) TLS/cert chain in WSL environment; (2) server-side policy gating for invite/SSO-created orgs. On the client side we should not silence original TLS errors by falling back to any different auth attempt.
ben: I inspected policy logs for the org: org.payment_metadata is null, owner roles are incomplete for invite flow, policy engine inferred 'needs_org_admin' and returned POLICY_RESTRICTED. billing_required flag is computed separately and was false. Looks like a policy inference bug.
liz: Action items: devex: add troubleshooting note to quickstart about WSL CA bundles and corp SSL proxies. infra: fix policy inference to align billing_required and policy codes and include a helpful link in error payload. sdk: change retry/error behavior so TLS errors are surfaced clearly and we don't auto-toggle auth headers.
ankit: I'll open infra ticket POLICY-1427 with logs. Ben, can you draft a short support reply we can paste?
ben: Draft support reply: "Hi — thanks for the report. If you signed up via SSO or invite, please complete your org setup in Console > Billing (Workspace). If you've done that and still see 403, reply with trace_id=tr_ABCD9876 and we'll escalate. Also, on Windows/WSL, ensure ca-certificates are installed in WSL or your corporate root cert is trusted. Example: sudo apt-get install ca-certificates."
sam: I'll send that as a reply.
maya: I'll validate infra fix when ready  happy to test with multiple SSO invite flows.
support-bot: (automated) Created tickets: SUPPORT-8912 (user-facing), POLICY-1427 (infra).
liz: For quickstart docs I'll add a small WSL troubleshooting block: "If you see SSL cert errors in WSL: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install ca-certificates && sudo update-ca-certificates". Also add SSO invite note about manual billing completion.
ankit: Assigning POLICY-1427 to @ben for policy engine change. Ben will follow up here once the error code and message include a link to the Console billing page.
ben: Will update by EOD. :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks folks. I'll close the user loop and update the ticket with the support message.
